patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient reports a 2-month history of persistent fatigue and several episodes of lower abdominal pain. Despite being on sick leave for 2 weeks, symptoms have not improved. She expresses a concern that she might have cancer and requests a diagnostic laparoscopy. She was diagnosed with peptic ulcer disease 6 months ago.
patient_actor_hidden.Past_Medical_History: Diagnosed with peptic ulcer disease 6 months prior, currently taking omeprazole.
patient_actor_hidden.Social_History: Works as a nurse, has been under a lot of stress at work.

Review_of_Systems.Skin: Numerous crusts along the left arm veins
Review_of_Systems.Cardiovascular: Grade 2/6 systolic ejection murmur along the right-upper sternal border
Review_of_Systems.Musculoskeletal: Generalized weakness of the proximal muscles

objective_for_doctor: Evaluate and manage a patient presenting with fatigue, episodes of lower abdominal pain, and a self-stated high cancer concern.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “I’m a 26-year-old nurse, and for about two months I’ve had persistent fatigue and a few episodes of lower abdominal pain. I’ve been off work on sick leave for two weeks, but I’m not feeling any better, and I’m under a lot of stress.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any yellowing of your skin or the whites of your eyes?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any yellowing of my skin or in the whites of my eyes.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you feel stiffness in your joints or muscles when you first wake up in the morning?
turns.patient_answer: “Not really stiffness in my joints when I wake up, but I do feel generalized weakness, especially in my proximal muscles, and it’s been making mornings and daily tasks harder.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling confused lately—like you’re having trouble thinking clearly, staying oriented, or understanding what’s going on?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t felt confused or disoriented—my thinking is clear—but I do feel very tired and low in mood, and it’s been harder to keep up with everyday tasks.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been having night sweats—waking up during the night drenched in sweat or needing to change your clothes or sheets?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had night sweats or had to change my clothes or sheets. I just mainly feel persistently exhausted, and my low mood and weakness have been continuing despite being off work.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed a firm lump or swelling inside your thigh muscle (not just on the skin), especially one that’s been there for a while or is getting bigger?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any firm lump or swelling in my thigh muscles, either inside or on the skin, and nothing seems to be getting bigger.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any skin lesions or unusual spots along the veins on your arm (for example, along the inner arm where veins are more visible)?
turns.patient_answer: “I’ve noticed numerous crusts along the left arm veins, but I haven’t had any other new unusual spots or lesions elsewhere.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you ever worked in a job where you might breathe in metal dust or metal fumes—for example welding, grinding, cutting, machining, construction/renovation with metal, or working in a foundry or metal shop? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No—at work I don’t do welding, grinding, or metal fumes exposure; I’m mainly a nurse doing patient care. I do feel persistently exhausted with weakness in my proximal muscles, and I’ve been worried something serious could be going on.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any swelling or enlargement around your joints that feels bony or hard (for example in the fingers, knuckles, knees, or hips)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any swelling or hard, bony enlargement around my joints—no finger or knuckle changes, and no obvious hard areas around my knees or hips. It’s mainly the persistent fatigue, depressed mood, and the generalized weakness in my proximal muscles that are worrying me.”

turns.doctor_question: I’m sorry you’re dealing with this. **Do you have pain in your thigh right now**—yes or no?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t have pain in my thigh right now—my main issues are persistent fatigue and generalized weakness, along with the episodes of lower abdominal pain I’ve had over the past two months.”

turns.doctor_question: I’m sorry you’re dealing with this—can I ask: **do you experience pain or discomfort during sex (either at the entrance or deeper inside)?**
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t have pain or discomfort during sex—my main problems are the persistent fatigue and generalized weakness, plus the intermittent lower abdominal pain over the last two months.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any scattered skin lesions—like small bumps, spots, or sores—appearing in different areas of your body? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: “No—I haven’t noticed scattered skin lesions or small bumps/sores appearing in different areas of my body. I’ve mainly just seen numerous crusts along the left arm veins, along with the persistent fatigue and generalized weakness.”
